question: Out of the colours listed, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

By checking all the options:

__
 
• All red, blue, and yellow are Primary Colors.

Whereas, 

 
• **Orange is a Secondary Color (Red +Yellow)**

Hence, **orange **is the odd one out.
